title: model-catalog: add capability filters and pricing/limits fields (streaming, tools, structured output, openai-compat)
author: Ava Martinez
description: Adds richer model catalog capability endpoints and response fields to support filtering by streaming/tool/function-calling/structured-output capabilities and to expose pricing and token limits for each model. Motivation: product and SDK teams need machine-readable capability flags and per-model pricing/limits to make routing and cost-based decisions (Dedicated routing, client-side SDK fallbacks, and OpenAI-compat shims). This change introduces new query parameters on GET /v1/models, expands the model descriptor response schema, updates OpenAPI, adds compatibility flags for OpenAI compatibility layer, and includes tests and docs. Backwards compatibility: existing fields are preserved; new fields are additive. Linear: ENG-1423 and PM-87. Related support ticket SUP-402. Checklist: - [x] API handler and query params - [x] Response schema fields (capabilities, pricing, limits) - [x] OpenAPI update and generator run - [x] SDK updates (python/typescript) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs and examples - [x] Regression tests for existing endpoints Notes: the pricing fields are strings to avoid floating point rounding issues in clients (e.g., "0.0003" tokens-per-1k). Limits are integers exposed as strings for consistency across SDKs. Streaming-supported models include a new capability flag. OpenAI-compat flag is added to let the compatibility layer prefer models that match endpoint behavior. No breaking changes to existing production callers were identified, but clients parsing model responses should ignore unknown fields. See release notes below for SDK guidance.
commits: feat(models): add capability flags and pricing/limits to model descriptor
feat(api): add query params to /v1/models (supports_streaming, supports_tools, supports_structured_output, min_price, max_price, openai_compat)
test: add integration tests for capability filters and pricing queries

release_notes: Added model catalog capability flags and pricing/limits fields. New query params for GET /v1/models: supports_streaming, supports_tools, supports_structured_output, min_price, max_price, openai_compat. Response now includes capabilities (array), pricing_per_1k (string), max_input_tokens (string), max_output_tokens (string), openai_compat (enum). SDKs regenerated. Clients should ignore unknown fields. See docs/api/models.md for examples.
